news.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.hotbed: Travellers say %s has become a hotbed of trafficking and gambling; its back rooms deal in %s.
news.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.jailed: %s was thrown in %s's cells for trafficking.
news.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.escaped: %s broke out of %s's cells and is wanted there.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.gazer.0: %s swears a light in the sky has moved three nights running, and is selling charts to anyone who will listen.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.gazer.1: %s was up all night with a paper and a lamp, and says the sky is not as empty as it looks.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.gazer.2: %1$s has been seen pointing at nothing, at dusk. The villagers call it a habit; %1$s calls it a trade.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.gazer.3: %s says there are lights that were not on the old charts, and wonders who will draw the new ones.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.raiders.0: A light fell out of the sky near %s, and then another. Nobody went to look until morning.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.raiders.1: Folk of %s saw a string of fire come down on the far fields. The smell of it stayed.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.raiders.2: Something burning came down past %s in the dark, loud as a barn falling. Then armed strangers on the road.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.raiders.3: Lights fell on %s's side of the hills. The dogs would not stop.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.patrol.0: A stranger in odd armour was seen at dusk outside %s, stepping out of a bright shell. He nodded and said nothing.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.patrol.1: A light came down slow and gentle by %s this evening. Whoever came out of it did not look like a raider.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.patrol.2: Shepherds near %s saw a lantern fall and stand upright. A tall stranger walked off it towards the town.
news.jaymoskingdoms.sky.patrol.3: At dusk a calm light set down by %s. By lamp-lighting it was gone again, and the grass lay flat in a ring.
news.jaymoskingdoms.landing_yard.0: A pod of the Galactic Patrol stood down on a pad of %s's landing yard this morning. The lamp on the post burned until it left.
news.jaymoskingdoms.landing_yard.1: %s keeps a landing yard now, and the sky-folk use it: a patrol pod came down on its pads as neat as a cart in a stable.
news.jaymoskingdoms.landing_yard.2: Travellers say %s is a stop on the Patrol's route. Its yard had a pod standing in it, and the merchants were pleased.
